mode: Built-in image generation for photographic artwork; precise SVG composition with controlled text substitutions and additions.

sources.name: explicit-tableware-photo
sources.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: photographic panel for a believable printed studio-pottery product card. Primary request: a single handmade warm ivory stoneware mug sitting on a matching shallow saucer on an ordinary pale wooden breakfast table. The mug and separate saucer are both clearly visible and have matching subtle speckled glaze. Quiet editorial product photography, modest craft-studio feel, soft natural window light and genuine ceramic texture. A small unbranded linen napkin may sit outside the product silhouette. No people, hands, readable writing, logos, prices or watermarks. Edge-to-edge photograph only, no card, packaging, graphic design or labels. Landscape 3:2 image, framed to retain both mug and saucer in a shallow wide photo band.

comparisonPolicy: Hire screen changes only the button words and adds one immediate consequence line. Completion report changes only the definition label and adds one denominator line. Tableware card adds two inclusion/price-scope lines. All other words, typography, positions, images/crops, palette and photographic presentation remain identical. Static fictional examples; no live booking or sale.
